title: Fix products not displaying on product page

requirements.text: Debug and fix the getAllProducts query in ProductsPage.tsx which is failing to fetch and display products from the backend despite successful deployments

quotes: again no product in product page

acceptanceCriteria: Products array is successfully fetched from backend main.mo getAllProducts method
Products are rendered in the grid layout on the products page
Console logs show successful data fetching without errors
Product cards display with correct image, name, price, and add-to-cart functionality

requirements.text: Verify and fix the backend getAllProducts method in main.mo to ensure it returns all products correctly with all required fields (id, name, description, price, category, imageUrl)

quotes: again no product in product page

acceptanceCriteria: getAllProducts method returns all stored products from the products HashMap
Each product contains all required fields with valid data
Method can be successfully called from frontend via the ICP actor
Response format matches the Product type expected by frontend

requirements.text: Add comprehensive error logging to track the complete data flow from backend query through React Query to component rendering, capturing any transformation or mapping issues
acceptanceCriteria: Console logs show the raw backend response from getAllProducts
Logs capture any data transformation steps in useGetAllProducts hook
Component rendering logs show the final products array being passed to ProductCard components
Error boundaries catch and display any runtime errors during product rendering

requirements.text: Ensure the actor instance in useActor.ts is correctly initialized and connected to the deployed backend canister, with proper error handling for connection failures
acceptanceCriteria: Actor instance successfully connects to the backend canister
Canister ID is correctly configured for the deployed environment
Connection errors are caught and logged with actionable messages
Query calls through the actor return valid responses

constraints: Do not modify the Internet Identity authentication hooks (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts)
Do not change the single-actor backend architecture in main.mo
Preserve all existing product CRUD functionality in the admin dashboard
Maintain the current React Query setup and caching strategy
nonGoals: Redesigning the product card layout or styling
Adding new product features or fields
Modifying the cart or checkout functionality
